rows.definition: The gateway's per-request loop depth for a looped model: the loop count selected for a chat request, the model's max loops, and whether the count came from the request (top-level loops or vllm_xargs.loops) or the model default. Emitted as fak.loop_depth on the chat response.
rows.distinction: Request-time recurrent depth chosen at the OpenAI-compatible gateway ingress, not the model's static loop pass count in its hyperparameters (Inkling2LoopHParams) and not an agent loop or retry loop.
